title: Exporting billing to BigQuery and answering "who spent this?"

videos.script: The console's cost table answers the questions somebody put in it. The billing export answers the rest. {{export}} Cloud Billing writes every line of the bill into a BigQuery dataset you own. From then on, a question about cost is a query. {{dataset}} The dataset is yours to create. The export is switched on by a person, in the console, and it starts that day. Nothing before it is in there. {{start}} Your lab has no bill. So you write a program that invents a month of rows, in the export's shape, and you query it with DuckDB. {{month}} Two things in that shape matter. Labels and credits are lists, one per row. And cost is a floating-point number, so you round at the end. {{shape}} Then three questions. What is the bill once credits come off? Which team spent it? And what was spent by nobody, on a machine with no label? {{questions}} That last one is the first to read. It is the cost nobody will answer for. {{end}}
